name: Productive Coaching benchmark (Quill.org)
summary: A planned benchmark, with educator-written feedback and annotated AI coaching sessions from several learning tools, for judging whether an AI's coaching on student writing is productive.

license.note: Stated intent on the project page, for its leaderboard and adoption package; not yet stated for each dataset.

access_note: A public leaderboard is planned, hosted by Learning Commons.
cite: Quill.org. The "Productive Coaching" Benchmark: Validating Coaching Quality in Student-Facing, AI-Powered Learning Tools. K-12 AI Infrastructure Program project, https://k12-ai-infrastructure.org/quill/
expected: The project page gives no date; the Program expects its new public goods to be released in summer 2027.

fits.how: Its rubric and scoring could rate coaching replies in agent tests.
